meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将频道连接到代理组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个频道与代理组的映射关系
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage mappings between channels and agent groups

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能查看并管理“消息渠道↔agent 组”的接线:展示哪些渠道已接好、未接或未配置;按你选的隔离级别新建接线,把渠道(如 Slack、Telegram)连到指定 agent 组;也能修改现有接线或添加同平台的新群。
howto.when: 在添加新渠道之后、初始设置期间,或想重新配置现有接线时,由你提出要求后触发。首次尚无 agent 组时,Claude 会先引导运行 /init-first-agent。

say.text: 展示当前所有渠道的接线情况
say.note: 列出已接、未接与未配置的渠道

say.text: 给 Telegram 加一个新群,接给独立 agent,文件夹叫 support
say.note: 创建新 agent 组并接线

howto.what_en: Claude can inspect and manage channel-to-agent-group wirings: it lists which channels are wired, configured-but-unwired, or unconfigured; creates new wirings based on your isolation choice; and can modify existing wirings or add a new group on the same platform.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask after adding a channel, during initial setup, or to reconfigure existing wirings. If no agent group exists yet, it delegates to /init-first-agent first.

say_en.text: Wire Slack #general to agent group A using the same conversation.
Show me the current wiring for all channels.
say_en.note: Lists wired, unwired, and unconfigured channels.

say_en.text: Add a new Telegram group connected to a separate agent, folder support.
say_en.note: Creates a new agent group and wiring.
